stories.title: Sondertribunal in Den Haag: Kosovos Ex-Präsident Hashim Thaçi zu 25 Jahren Haft verurteilt

en.title: Special tribunal in The Hague: Kosovo's former president Hashim Thaçi sentenced to 25 years in prison
en.summary: The Kosovo special tribunal in The Hague convicted former president Hashim Thaçi of war crimes and sentenced him to 25 years imprisonment. Thaçi had denied the allegations against him.

stories.title: 25 Jahre Haft: Kosovo-Tribunal spricht Hashim Thaçi schuldig

en.title: 25 years in prison: Kosovo tribunal finds Hashim Thaçi guilty
en.summary: A Kosovo tribunal sentenced former president Hashim Thaçi to 25 years in prison. The conviction raises questions about Western cooperation with a person convicted of war crimes.

stories.title: Sommerferien: Trotz hoher Spritpreise – ADAC zählt acht Prozent mehr Staus

en.title: Summer vacation: Despite high fuel prices – ADAC counts eight percent more traffic jams
en.summary: Germans increased car travel during summer 2026 despite rising fuel costs. The ADAC recorded traffic jams totaling 217,730 kilometers in length during the holiday period.

stories.title: Gaza-Stadt: Hamas meldet viele Tote und Verschüttete nach Gebäudeeinsturz

en.title: Gaza City: Hamas reports many dead and trapped after building collapse
en.summary: A multi-story residential building in Gaza City collapsed following Israeli airstrikes despite an ongoing ceasefire. Multiple fatalities and injuries were reported, with dozens of people feared missing.

stories.title: Regierung legt Zehn-Punkte-Plan gegen Terror vor

en.title: Government presents ten-point plan against terror
en.summary: The federal government plans to take stronger action against terrorism, propaganda, and violence through increased surveillance of dangerous individuals and harsher penalties for knife attacks, with the justice minister describing the threat as serious.

stories.title: Diskussion über Friedrich Merz: CDU-Ministerpräsidenten unterstützen Bundeskanzler Merz

en.title: Discussion about Friedrich Merz: CDU state premiers support Chancellor Merz
en.summary: Following the election in Saxony-Anhalt, debate has emerged over Friedrich Merz's future, but CDU state premiers have united behind their party chairman.

stories.title: Anschlag auf den Berliner CSD: Regierung kündigt Zehn-Punkte-Plan gegen islamistischen Terror an

en.title: Attack on Berlin CSD: Government announces ten-point plan against Islamist terror
en.summary: In response to Islamist terrorism, the federal government has announced stricter criminal penalties, including enhanced punishment for fundraising activities benefiting terrorist organizations.

stories.title: Friedrich Merz und Bundesregierung: CDU-Ministerpräsidenten warnen vor Planspielen mit Minderheitsregierung

en.title: Friedrich Merz and federal government: CDU state premiers warn against minority government scenarios
en.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz faces significant pressure as CDU state premiers have issued a joint statement urging stability and implicitly opposing personnel discussions.

en.title: Federal Government: CDU State Premiers Back Merz
en.summary: CDU state premiers have issued a joint letter supporting the chancellor, who had previously faced isolation. The premiers are calling for an end to personnel discussions.

stories.title: "Europäischer Sicherheitsrat geplant", Christian Feld, ARD Brüssel, über Rede zur Lage der EU von Ursula von der Leyen

en.title: European Security Council Planned, Christian Feld, ARD Brussels, on Ursula von der Leyen's State of the EU Address
en.summary: European Union leadership is planning the establishment of a European Security Council, as discussed in the state of the EU address.

stories.title: ADAC: Mehr Staus in den Sommerferien 2026

en.title: ADAC: More Traffic Jams in Summer 2026
en.summary: Summer 2026 saw increased traffic congestion on highways, though jams were shorter than the previous year. Despite record-high fuel prices, many drivers still traveled by car.

stories.title: Saudi-Arabien wehrt offenbar Huthi-Drohne bei Mekka ab

en.title: Saudi Arabia Reportedly Repels Houthi Drone near Mecca
en.summary: The Houthi militia allegedly attempted to attack Mecca with a drone, according to Saudi military reports. Saudi Arabia says it successfully intercepted the attack and describes it as crossing a red line.

stories.title: Dax aktuell: Investoren vor Fed-Entscheid „hochgradig nervös“ – Dax leicht im Plus

en.title: Dax currently: Investors "highly nervous" ahead of Fed decision – Dax slightly in plus
en.summary: Ahead of an anticipated interest rate decision by the US Federal Reserve, major stock indices show little movement while bond yields decline slightly.

stories.title: Mobilität: Strom statt Benzin – wie viel spart ein E-Auto beim Tanken ein?

en.title: Mobility: Electricity instead of petrol – how much does an electric car save on fuel?
en.summary: Fuel prices remain elevated due to the Iran conflict. A calculator tool compares potential savings between charging an electric vehicle and purchasing traditional petrol.

stories.title: Kritik am Kanzler: CDU-Ministerpräsidenten stellen sich hinter Merz

en.title: Criticism of Chancellor: CDU Minister-Presidents Stand Behind Merz
en.summary: Chancellor Merz faces a crisis situation. CDU state premiers have publicly expressed support for him and opposed discussions about personnel changes.

stories.title: Geldanlage: Auf diese zehn Aktien setzen viele Vermögensverwalter – wie Analysten die Titel einschätzen

en.title: Investment: Many wealth managers are betting on these ten stocks – how analysts assess the securities
en.summary: An analysis of 50,000 portfolios reveals that professional wealth managers' preferred stocks differ significantly from global indices, with five German companies among their favorites alongside other holdings.
